svg.title: LOVE GROWS HERE - Interchangeable Welcome Home Sign
svg.desc: Size 8.00 x 4.00 in (203.2 x 101.6 mm). 1 unit = 1 mm. RED = cut (all closed paths, text converted to outlines). BLUE = optional score/engrave border (do not cut through). Personal and small-batch physical sales only - do not share or resell this file.
